results.description:
He who holds the key can unlock the heart...

Sabrina

Being jilted at the altar is supposed to suck, but when Sabrina Darren's fiancé stands her up at an elegant wedding in Paris, it's almost freeing. Before she can enjoy escaping a romance-less future and never having that big moment of being in love, she has to figure out how to confront the uglier side effects. Like the fact her fiancé was the key to a merger for her family's publishing company. And that her sister was sleeping with him all along.

Sabrina avoids facing the music, though. When she wanders the streets of Paris and gets stuck near the famous locks of love fence, a surprisingly helpful stranger manages to distract her.

There's something secretive about her hero, but on a whim, she invites him to share her honeymoon week with her. At the end of it, though… a big surprise threatens to unravel her world.

Nate

Stuck in an acting career where everyone knows him and wants a piece of his fame, Nate Murphy would love a chance to hide and just be. Skipping out of a press conference, he takes his friends' advice to lie low for the small break between filming movies. But meeting a bride on the run shifts his priorities for lying low.

A weeklong fling is just what he needs to take a step back from reality. It's even more exciting because she has no clue who he really is. With them sticking to no details and him shaving his beard, it's as incognito as he'll get.

Once their agreed-upon time is cut short with the paparazzi getting too close, he wonders how he'll be able to share his identity without it being the surprise that might break her.
